q.en: If 4, x, 25 are in GP, find positive x.
q.as: 4, x, 25 গুণোত্তৰ শ্ৰেণীত থাকিলে ধনাত্মক x উলিওৱা।

why.en: $x^2 = 4 \times 25$: the continued proportion from Ratio.
That is the AP middle. In a GP the middle is $\sqrt{ac}$.
